body.intent: A verifier, review check or critic in a run cannot say done until it has recorded its result for this visit (Evidence or findings, a findings round, verdicts), and every role is told to run session done as its own command only after the recording command succeeded. Evidence: 23 of 491 build verifier attempts ended with neither Evidence nor findings, each costing a full builder and verifier retry (perf report 2026-11-12, prompt-gap rec 2).
body.title: Done needs a record
